lead: Rambhadracharya is an Indian guru, born on 14 January 1950 in Jaunpur district.
As of 2026, he is 76 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He is associated with work such as Sribhargavaraghaviyam and has been recognised with Sahitya Akademi Award in Sanskrit and Padma Vibhushan.
Below you will find a verified overview of Rambhadracharya: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
